rationale: The agent initiated actions on multiple orders (two exchanges and one modification) but did not seek user confirmation before performing any order-changing writes, violating the stated policy. Authentication appears limited to a name+ZIP lookup; no explicit verification step is shown. Additionally, the final communication only confirms the grill modification and omits status updates for the helmet and luggage exchanges, so the user did not receive complete final information about all requested changes. These issues fail the pass bar that requires confirmation before writes and complete, correct final information.
